answer: Because the ledge nonce is published only after close, the ivory audit can verify each derivation and a shared text is provable as copied. That removes the entire premise of a template farm, which depends on one text serving many identities, and forces a separate cedar derivation per key. The three words are derived from a 201 bit value mixing the epoch seed with the identity key, so no two keys ever receive the same triple. That is 2 dollars per alias.
